eps.t: The Promise That Started It All
eps.ov: A young escapee and a listless hunter meet by chance, unaware of the covenant that will soon bind them.
eps.oa: تلتقي هاربة صغيرة وصياد فاتر الهمة مصادفة، ولا يدريان بالعهد الذي سيربطهما قريباً.

eps.ov: Their pact grants Jiro and Kumi the power to defend the town from the giant beast. It also exposes their location to Imperial forces.
eps.oa: يمنح العهد «جيرو» و«كومي» القوة ليدافعا عن البلدة من الوحش العملاق، لكنه يكشف موضعهما لقوات الإمبراطورية أيضاً.

eps.ov: Low on supplies and with their escape route cut off, the three companions seek shelter in a nearby village. There, they meet a youth who dreams of becoming a Paladin.
eps.oa: تقل مؤن الرفاق الثلاثة وتُقطع طريق فرارهم، فيلتمسون المأوى في قرية قريبة، فيلتقون هناك شاباً يحلم بأن يصير من «الفرسان».

eps.ov: Jiro underestimates a mysterious traveler and loses his spear in a game of chance. She has an agenda, but what interest could she have with a Cleric and a Paladin?
Jiro has a violent history with the people of the mountains. When the group finds themselves in their village, the inhabitants challenge the Paladin to a test of strength.
Kumi dreads there’s a connection between her and the red-eyed beasts. And when her friends try to help her, they may all end up with more questions than answers.

eps.t: Violet Evokes the Memory of Horns
eps.ov: Jiro was married once. Her name was Toka, and this is how their story began — and ended.
Kumi used to be an empty shell of a person until a fateful encounter changed her life. Now, she seeks to save a counterpart from her cruel fate.
Jiro and his friends WILL put an end to the Imperial experiments. However, they are not the only ones with the conviction to do what must be done. Conflict is inevitable.
Kumi and the others launch an assault on the laboratory to save the prototypes. However, Mezami hasn’t come this far just to see his ambitions go down in flames.
Kumi can either live the little time she may have left as a normal girl or continue fighting. Jiro and the others have their opinions, but what does Kumi want?
Giant beasts attack the people of Ars en masse, forcing everyone to fight for their very lives. As chaos reigns, Myaa prepares to unleash her trump card.
